text:
maria.cs: Kickoff — Asteria Labs dedicated pool bring-up. Quota set to 120K tokens/min, autoscale policy capping at 12 GPUs. Need final signoff on loadtest window. Planned: tomorrow 02:00-04:00 PT.

alex.solutions: I can run the customer-facing enablement at 03:00PT, will need the test endpoint and ephemeral creds.

jason.sre: SRE checklist: monitoring dashboards ready, alerting thresholds set (p99 latency > 700ms -> page), circuit-breaker enabled. I'll drop the grafana link in a sec.

kai.eng: Kernel selection note: for this model we should force int8 quant path to hit target throughput; otherwise GPU mem will blow during long sequences.

maria.cs: @kai.eng send the quant override flag for the test. Also need load script - customer will do half the traffic, we do shadow replay.

kai.eng: Load script snippet:
```
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=2000 -duration=1m | vegeta report
```
Targets file uses the /v1/generate endpoint with X-Api-Key header. Will attach later.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for pool ast-ast-priv-01, image redwood/inference:prod-2026-03-21 :rocket:

jason.sre: Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd123/asteria-pool - added token-level RPS, batch size histogram, KV cache hit-rate.

alex.solutions: For enablement deck: can someone export the sample latency charts post smoke? Need pngs by 02:30PT.

maria.cs: Risk note: Asteria's renewal touchpoint is scheduled in 10 days; if we hit sustained p95 > 400ms during trials, they escalate. Keep that in mind for traffic shape.

kai.eng: I'll run two passes: steady-state 2k RPS for 30m then burst storms 10k RPS for 5m each. Will annotate each run.

maria.cs: Perfect. Final action items: kai — attach load targets + quant flag by EOD. jason — validate alerts and run dry-run smoke. alex — prepare enablement deck slides. I'll coordinate with Asteria for the 02:00 window. :thumbsup:

alex.solutions: :eyes: I'll prep slides and test creds request template.

maria.cs: Thanks team. If there are any blockers ping me directly. :raised_hands:
